⚠️ **Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

If you have discovered a security vulnerability, please email the maintainer privately. Include as much detail as possible so the issue can be assessed and addressed promptly.

Do not disclose the vulnerability publicly until a fix has been released.
